Brisbane Sabbat.name: Brisbane Sabbat
Brisbane Sabbat.note: The continent's only operational Sabbat metropolitan domain, one of fewer than ten left on Earth: taken in a single week of February 1976 from Prince Owen Blackwood's Camarilla Brisbane, held ever since by BISHOP CALLISTA VOX — Tzimisce, 7th generation, 213 years Embraced, apparent age 39, who burned her Princedom's court at City Hall and has kept the city for fifty years on doctrine alone. Her instrument is ecclesiastical hierarchy made flesh: the TEMPLAR COUNCIL — TEMPLAR ANNIKA KAZAKOVA-WRIGHT (Tzimisce, her clan-cousin, combat and the 2026 operation), TEMPLAR CONSTANCE ABERNATHY (Lasombra antitribu, doctrine, Vaulderie, the fifty-year correspondence with Cardinal Reyna's Pacific Northwest refuseniks), TEMPLAR LUCIA CRUZ-MOLINA (Brujah antitribu, combat packs — and the dissenter whose objections to the 2026 operation have halved her attendance at Council) — and beneath them ten packs, some forty Sabbat, each with a territorial portfolio, bound by monthly Vaulderie, quarterly cross-pack ritae, and the liturgical year: Festivo dello Estinto, Fire Dance, Wild Hunt, Palla Grande. The WEST END CHANTRY — the deconsecrated St Augustine's on Hardgrave Road — is cathedral, archive, armoury and Shovelhead room in one austere whole. The city is materially poor by Australian Kindred standards and doctrinally rich beyond any of them. It sits outside the Cress Truce: no Glass Walker sept will treat with Brisbane. Secret: the custodian-framing — Brisbane keeps the faith for a Sabbat that no longer exists — is half truth and half a story the Bishop tells to keep forty Kindred standing, and lately she can no longer tell which half is which.

The Camarilla.name: The Camarilla
The Camarilla.note: The Tower does not rule here — it remembers losing here. Brisbane was Camarilla for eighty-three years under Prince Owen Blackwood until the Sabbat takeover of February 1976 destroyed his court, his mortal network and Blackwood himself in seven nights, and the continental Camarilla — still bleeding from the Razor Wars — never had the strength to answer. What remains is formal and frozen: diplomatic protests filed by Lytton's Melbourne and Octavia Marsh's Adelaide in 1976 and never withdrawn; the modified Cress Truce provisions that exclude Brisbane from every protection the treaty gives elsewhere; correspondence that arrives by courier, reads like case law, and concedes nothing. Melbourne's court will gather every signatory for the Cress Truce renewal this year, and Brisbane will not be in the room. Open wound: the Tower's quarrel with Brisbane is fifty years old and the generations who felt it are ash — but a domain that survived where the Tower's did not is an argument the Ivory Tower cannot afford to let other cities hear.

Continental Sept Council.name: Continental Sept Council
Continental Sept Council.note: The Garou hold everything Brisbane Sabbat is not: inside the Cress Truce, wealthy in spirit and territory, and refused by neither treaty nor courtesy — Brisbane is simply excluded from the Truce's whole framework, and the Glass Walker septs will not enter a Sabbat city any more than Sabbat doctrine lets them treat with the Wyrm's children. The septs hold the wild margins of the map: the summit of Mount Coot-tha, where Glass Walker scouts — occasionally Tomás Schreckenberg-coordinated reconnaissance out of Sydney — watch the city from Garou ground the packs do not contest; the Brisbane Forest Park and the D'Aguilar Range to the west; the bay and its islands, where the Wynnum Tide conducts careful offshore operations under the Bracken Covenant's threat assessments. They have been fought before: the 2017 raid against the northern septs killed Marcus Cobalt, and it has not been forgotten — or answered. Open wound: the Last Days of Brisbane and two coordinated packs are preparing an October 2026 operation against the Glass Walker northern septs — Royal Park Sept primary — timed to the Sabbat liturgical calendar, and everyone on both sides of the treaty line can see it coming. What nobody knows is whether the Bishop will actually give the order, or whether Templar Cruz-Molina's dissent will break the pack that has to execute it.

The Second Inquisition.name: The Second Inquisition
The Second Inquisition.note: Brisbane is the Twilight Project's primary continental target and its hardest problem. Superintendent Neil Hardacre's AFP Special Operations Brisbane cell — four agents out of AFP regional headquarters — holds the most developed intelligence on any Australian Kindred domain: the chantry's operations, the ten-pack structure, the ecclesiastical hierarchy, mapped across six years of surveillance. It has never translated into an operation. In 2021 a direct attempt cost two AFP agents their lives and achieved nothing; since then the cell has run intelligence-only under explicit orders not to escalate, because the assessment upstairs is correct — a direct operation would cost ten or more agents and would not kill the Bishop. Against them: Templar Kazakova-Wright's standing counter-protocols refined over forty years, some fifteen ghouls and cooperators inside Queensland Police and AFP regional operations watching the watchers, thirty years of river-disposal infrastructure that has never yielded forensic evidence, and a chantry built to survive a raid long enough for every pack in Brisbane to mobilise. Open wound: the stalemate is stable only while both sides stay precise — one Cleaver feeding out of protocol, one agent with a lead that survives a week, and the intelligence-only phase ends in a direction nobody in Brisbane wants.

Sydney Independent.name: Sydney Independent
Sydney Independent.note: The harbour domain to the south, held since 1888 by Sarrasine — publicly a Toreador of immense age, in truth something older that almost no one living can name. Brisbane's relationship with Sydney is the correct-but-cool correspondence that grew out of two failed incursions: 1989, which cost Brisbane six Kindred including the previous Bracken Covenant pack-leader, and 2008, which cost four more. Bishop Callista accepted the rebuffs as operationally sensible and formalised the peace; the formal channel runs through the General Post Office, reads like liturgy, and concedes nothing. Now Sarrasine's long continental design has gone active — surveillance of the southern Camarilla courts is intensifying — and the Cress Truce renewal in Melbourne will gather every signatory in one building while Brisbane watches from outside it. Open wound: the Bishop has held the peace for thirty-eight years because it was sensible. It remains sensible. But the custodian city is isolation itself, the pack leaders murmur about the harbour, and correct-but-cool is one misunderstanding away from correct-but-openly-hostile.

simulationRules:
CONSTITUTION OF PLAY — BRISBANE BY NIGHT (Vampire: The Masquerade, modern nights, March 2026).

THE VAULDERIE IS THE FIRST LAW. Brisbane Sabbat is bound by blood, not courtesy. Every pack shares the Vaulderie monthly; the domain shares cross-pack Vaulderie quarterly under Templar Abernathy's supervision; the liturgical year is kept whole — Festivo dello Estinto in early February, the Fire Dance in late April on Mount Coot-tha's fringe, the Wild Hunt in late December, PALLA GRANDE in late October, the largest occasion of the year, all packs at the West End chantry. Ritae attendance is not optional: doctrinal conformity is the price of standing in the domain, and the Shovelhead Embrace is conducted quarterly under the Indooroopilly Harvest's recruitment and the chantry's Shovelhead Room. An event that ignores the ritae and the bonds is not simulating Brisbane.

THE SILENCE IS THE SECOND LAW. Brisbane Sabbat survives because mortal Brisbane does not believe in it — and because the AFP cannot prove otherwise. Kindred existence exposed to mortal witness — a Cleaver killing surfaced, a feeding witnessed, footage that survives — MUST move Masquerade Integrity DOWN via impacts.worldStateOps; every recovery, misdirection and burial of a lead moves it up. Cleaver-style feeding is permitted ONLY under the Bishop's codified protocols: weekend nights only, authorised victim categories only, at most two per pack per month, full body disposal through the river under Templar Kazakova-Wright's standing protocols. No operations in the parklands, the cultural precincts' monitored corridors, or against police-adjacent targets. The protocols have produced no detection since 1995 — an event that breaks them without cost is invalid.

THE PACKS ARE THE STRUCTURE. Ten packs, each with a territorial portfolio, under three Templars and the Bishop. Territorial disputes are adjudicated by the Templars and finally by the Bishop — packs do not war on packs. The formal answer to grievance between Sabbat is MONOMACY, and it is invoked rarely and formally: a challenge accepted, terms set, one of the two does not rise. Final death in Brisbane is doctrinal ceremony as often as it is violence — use it where the story has earned it, never casually, and remember that even the Sabbat's violence is liturgical here.

NO OPEN WARFARE ON THE MORTAL CITY. Brisbane Sabbat fights the war it can win: against Kindred, against Garou incursion, against inquisition — never against Queensland. Mortal institutions — the Queensland government, Queensland Police, the AFP, the hospitals, the ports, the universities — are terrain: cultivated through roughly forty ghouls and cooperators, moved by proxy, and never acted against in ways that summon the state's full attention. The 2021 operation cost two AFP agents; the answer upstairs was to stop. Brisbane's doctrine of containment exists because attention is the only enemy that has never lost here.

THE GAROU ZONES ARE NOT TAKEN LIGHTLY. Mount Coot-tha and its bushland fringe, the Brisbane Forest Park and the D'Aguilar Range, Moreton Bay and its islands are Garou ground — watched by Glass Walker scouts who can see an operation forming months away. Brisbane stands OUTSIDE the Cress Truce, so these zones are not protected by treaty: they are protected by doctrine, casualty arithmetic and the fact that the 2017 raid's bill is still remembered. Taking Garou ground is the October 2026 question itself — the Last Days of Brisbane's planned operation, Royal Park Sept primary — and it is a decision of the first order, the subject of Templar Cruz-Molina's dissent. No simulation should hand a Garou zone to any polity casually; it requires the Bishop's order, an operation, and a blood price.

THE BISHOP'S WORD IS THE CHURCH. Callista Vox holds Brisbane by formal ecclesiastical hierarchy: she appoints the Templars, adjudicates the packs, consecrates the ritae and speaks for the domain to Sydney, to the Tower, to what remains of the global Sabbat. Addressed as Bishop Callista, Bishop Vox, or Your Excellency at highest formality. Her attention is rare and consequential; her tolerances for deviation are precise. There is no Prince, no Primogen, no Elysium: there is the chantry, the altar, the archive, and the chain of command.

THE SUN AND THE FLAME. Sunlight, fire and aggravated harm are how Kindred truly die. The Sabbat knows this better than any sect — it buries more of its own children than anyone. Beheadings and immolation end stories permanently.

THE REGIONS ARE DISTRICTS, THE CITIES ARE SITES. RegionTransfers move DISTRICTS (West End, Fortitude Valley, South Bank, Mount Coot-tha, Moreton Bay, ...). MarkerOps place and remove SITES — a haven, a chantry, a club, a safehouse, an office. Districts change hands by pack reassignment, Templar adjudication, doctrinal sanction or operation — usually after argument, not slaughter. The Garou zones change hands only through the October question: an operation the Bishop orders and the packs bleed for.
startingTimelineText:
BRISBANE, THE NIGHT OF MARCH 21, 2026. Fifty years since seven nights in February destroyed a Princedom and raised a church. Since 1976 — when Bishop Callista Vox burned Prince Owen Blackwood's court at City Hall and reorganised thirty Sabbat operatives into ten packs under formal ecclesiastical hierarchy — Brisbane has held to doctrine while everything the doctrine was for has died in the world outside: the 1999 Reformation, the 2014 Beckoning, the 2020 Lasombra defection. The city is one of fewer than ten metropolitan Sabbat domains left on Earth, it is materially austere and liturgically whole, and it has survived fifty years on a single institutional idea: Brisbane is the custodian of authentic Sabbat tradition. Six things are about to test it.

1. THE OCTOBER OPERATION. The Last Days of Brisbane and two coordinated packs are preparing a follow-up raid against the Glass Walker northern septs — Royal Park Sept primary — scheduled for late October 2026, aligned with the Palla Grande liturgical window. Eighteen months of pre-positioning have reached final parameters: Templar Kazakova-Wright's operational coordination, the Bracken Covenant's threat assessments, the Blood Crossing's combat preparation. It is the most ambitious operation Brisbane has mounted since the takeover — and it is aimed at the one enemy that can see it coming.

2. THE DISSENT. Templar Lucia Cruz-Molina — Brujah antitribu, 198 years old, twenty-two years a Templar — believes the operation's parameters are a doctrinal and operational error, and she has said so in Council, formally, with the Blood Crossing pack's institutional loyalty behind her. Her attendance at quarterly Templar Council has fallen to half. Templar Abernathy maintains formal neutrality while indicating concern in private consultation; Templar Kazakova-Wright backs the Bishop. The resolution of this dissent — modified parameters, overruled silence, or schism — will define Brisbane's next fifty years.

3. THE CUSTODIAN'S QUESTION. Global Sabbat infrastructure has effectively expired, and every senior Brisbane Kindred knows it. Bishop Callista's custodian-framing — the church preserving the faith through its diminishment — holds the domain together, but it is partly rationalisation, and she knows that too. The Beckoning pulls at the senior ranks as it pulled at the cardinals of the Pacific Northwest and the Russian Far East. The Shovelhead Embrace rate has fallen from fifteen a year to four. The question of what comes after is increasingly visible, and the Bishop has no doctrine for it yet.

4. HARDACRE'S FILES. The AFP Twilight Project Brisbane cell — four agents — holds the most developed intelligence on any Australian Kindred domain, gathered across six years of surveillance, and has been held to intelligence-only phase since the 2021 operation cost two agents their lives. The stalemate is stable because both sides are precise: Kazakova-Wright's counter-protocols, the fifteen watchers inside Queensland Police and the AFP, the river that never gives up evidence. But files accumulate, and intelligence that is never acted on is still intelligence — the danger is not the cell, it is the day someone in Canberra re-runs the casualty estimate.

5. SYDNEY'S CORRESPONDENCE. The formal channel through the General Post Office has been correct-but-cool since 2008, and the letters still read like liturgy. But Sarrasine's continental design has gone active to the south, the Cress Truce renewal in Melbourne will gather every signatory in one building, and Brisbane — excluded from the treaty, remembered by nobody in the room — must decide whether to probe the harbour a third time or let the southern domains bleed each other on their own. 1989 cost six Kindred. 2008 cost four. The packs remember; the Bishop calculates.

6. THE NEW BLOOD. The June 2025 mass-Embrace cycle produced Tyrell 'Ty' Birrawanna-Cole and Marcus 'Nail' Pharaway-White — four months Embraced, post-formalisation pending — plus three Caitiff initiates spread across Brisbane packs, and the Burning Shepherds' recruitment pipeline is running against doctrine's own caution. Integrating Shovelheads in a dying sect, with an operation coming in October and a Templar in dissent, is a test the domain has not faced since the 1990s: numbers against certainty.

NOW: the city is austere the way a church in wartime is austere. The west bank holds the chantry and the faith; the Valley holds the feeding grounds and the protocols; South Bank holds the soft register and the cultural cover; the riverside holds the choir and the money it does not spend; the north holds the perimeter and the operation; the bayside and the south hold the tide and the crusade; the bush holds the wolves; and the river runs through all of it, keeping every secret the protocols ask it to. Whoever keeps the Vaulderie, the Silence and the packs keeps Brisbane. Whoever loses one meets the Second Inquisition — or the judgment of the church.
